components.text: Links two living creatures in the circle for a while (60 seconds unless the server changes it): half the damage either takes, the other takes too.

Only a witch type can work it. No NPC Original or boss can be linked. Another player must agree by sneaking in the circle with a lead in their main hand. A refusal always reads the same and costs the same.

A refusal still spends the lead, the amethyst and the altar's power. The grimoire always comes back.

Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.
